description.zh: 把素材库里的文件传到你的对象存储(阿里云 OSS / 腾讯云 COS / 火山引擎 TOS / Amazon S3 / S3 兼容服务),换回一条**公网直链** —— 有些供应商只收链接不收本地文件(方舟 Seedance 的参考视频就是一例)。也能列出桶里的对象、给已有对象签直链、把对象拉回素材库。
description.en: Upload assets to your object storage (Alibaba Cloud OSS / Tencent Cloud COS / Volcengine TOS / Amazon S3 / any S3-compatible service) and get a public link back — some providers only accept a URL, not a local file (Seedance's reference video is one). Also lists a bucket, signs links for existing objects and pulls objects back into the library.

help.zh: 连哪一家。一个连接对一个桶;要用几个桶就建几个连接,在「设置 → 素材外链」里选默认用哪一个。
help.en: Which service. One connection is one bucket; create one connection per bucket and pick the default under Settings → Asset links.

help.zh: 桶的名字。腾讯云要填带 APPID 的全名,如 examplebucket-1250000000(控制台存储桶列表里的那一列)。
help.en: The bucket name. For Tencent COS use the full name with the APPID suffix, e.g. examplebucket-1250000000.

help.zh: 桶所在的地域 ID:阿里云如 cn-hangzhou,腾讯云如 ap-guangzhou,火山引擎如 cn-beijing,AWS 如 us-east-1。S3 兼容服务按它自己的说法(Cloudflare R2 填 auto,MinIO 通常是 us-east-1)。
help.en: The bucket's region ID: cn-hangzhou (Alibaba), ap-guangzhou (Tencent), cn-beijing (Volcengine), us-east-1 (AWS). For an S3-compatible service use its own value (auto for Cloudflare R2, usually us-east-1 for MinIO).

help.zh: 云厂商通常留空,按地域自动拼(oss-<地域>.aliyuncs.com、cos.<地域>.myqcloud.com、tos-<地域>.volces.com、s3.<地域>.amazonaws.com);要填就填完整域名,不是地域名。S3 兼容服务必填,如 <账号>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com 或 http://localhost:9000,按路径式访问。
help.en: Usually empty for the cloud providers — built from the region (oss-<region>.aliyuncs.com, cos.<region>.myqcloud.com, tos-<region>.volces.com, s3.<region>.amazonaws.com); if set, give a full host, not a region. Required for an S3-compatible service, e.g. <account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com or http://localhost:9000 (path-style).

help.zh: 阿里云 AccessKey ID / 腾讯云 SecretId / 火山引擎 Access Key ID / AWS Access Key ID。建一个只对这个桶有读写权限的子用户,用它的密钥,别用主账号的。
help.en: Alibaba AccessKey ID / Tencent SecretId / Volcengine Access Key ID / AWS Access Key ID. Create a sub-user scoped to this bucket and use its key — not the root account's.

help.zh: 和上面那个 ID 成对的密钥:阿里云 AccessKey Secret / 腾讯云 SecretKey / 火山引擎 Secret Access Key / AWS Secret Access Key。
help.en: The secret paired with the ID above: Alibaba AccessKey Secret / Tencent SecretKey / Volcengine Secret Access Key / AWS Secret Access Key.

description.zh: 把一份素材传上去,交回一条**限时直链**(签名在查询串里,桶不必设成公共读)。这就是「本地文件怎么变成公网链接」的答案 —— 直接粘进生成节点的参考视频那一格。大文件分片上传,边传边报进度。
description.en: Upload an asset and hand back a time-limited direct link (the signature lives in the query string, so the bucket need not be public-read). This is how a local file becomes a URL. Large files go up in parts, with progress.

description.zh: 桶里的路径,留空就用 mosael/<内容指纹>/<原文件名>。
description.en: The object key; defaults to mosael/<content hash>/<filename>.

description.zh: 直链有效期(秒),默认 3600。阿里云 / 火山 / AWS 最长 7 天,超过按 7 天签。
description.en: How long the link stays valid, in seconds (3600 by default). Alibaba / Volcengine / AWS cap it at 7 days.

description.zh: 给桶里已有的对象签一条限时直链。
description.en: Sign a time-limited direct link for an object already in the bucket.

description.zh: 有效期(秒),默认 3600。阿里云 / 火山 / AWS 最长 7 天。
description.en: Seconds; 3600 by default. Alibaba / Volcengine / AWS cap it at 7 days.

description.zh: 把桶里的一个对象拉回素材库。**交回的是地址,由宿主搬字节** —— 进度、取消、重试都归它。
description.en: Pull an object back into the asset library. The plugin hands over a URL and the host moves the bytes — progress, cancel and retry all come for free.

description.zh: 列出桶里某个前缀下的对象(路径、大小、修改时间)。一页最多 1000 条,还有下一页时交回 next_cursor。
description.en: List objects under a prefix (key, size, last modified). Up to 1000 per page; next_cursor is returned when there is more.

description.zh: 路径前缀,留空就是整个桶。
description.en: Key prefix; empty means the whole bucket.

description.zh: 最多返回多少条,默认 100,上限 1000。
description.en: How many at most; 100 by default, 1000 at the top.

description.zh: 上一页交回的 next_cursor,留空从头列。
description.en: The next_cursor from the previous page; empty starts from the top.
